en: \[VSCode] Fixed dropping an Explorer folder onto the chat inserting nothing on VS Code 1.103 to 1.139 or in a floating chat window, and the drop highlight vanishing with a false "Hold Shift" hint
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在 VS Code 1.103 至 1.139 或浮动聊天窗口中，将资源管理器文件夹拖放到聊天中不插入任何内容，以及拖放高亮消失并错误显示“Hold Shift”提示的问题
